_about: Underground lighting in the Godot viewer (T-180, #305): ceiling lights in rooms and corridors, placed by the bridge (src/view/overheads.ts), and the modes Godot switches between by the hour (godot/src/Lighting.cs). Energies are Godot light energies; reaches in metres.

overhead._about: One ceiling light per room cell (10 m square) and one per corridorSpacingM of corridor, dropM under the ceiling.

switch._about: Lights switch mode at these hours (0..24): day from dawnHour, night from duskHour, rooms off from offHour until dawn. Each room switches at its own moment within spreadS real seconds of the hour, whatever the game speed; a room switches all its lights at once.

day._about: By day, underground: every ceiling light on, lamps lampBoost brighter (0.5 is half again), and colour of the daylight's colour boost (0..1).

night._about: By night: this share of ceiling lights stays on, dimmed to overheadDim; this share of lamps dims to lampDim. Which ones goes by a stable hash of where they are, so the same ones every night.

off._about: After offHour, rooms go dark: their lamps and ceiling lights to these shares (0 is off). Corridors stay in the night mode.
